notes: The published METEOR graph (meteor_v157c3Z.onnx, sha256 50397b4d..., Hugging Face AutowareFoundation/meteor) fed as shipped: raw uint8 into the graph's own /255, no mean/std normalisation, absent camera slots as zeros. Six rendered cameras fill six of the eight slots, so this row is in the 6cam-20Hz group and has no constant-velocity floor of its own. Driven by a native AlpaSim driver at 0.1.1 that is not tracked in this repository; the mode is chosen by the selector of METEOR's deployed runtime, not by argmax. The benchmark's ten public_2601 scenes: the first ten directories of the 30-scene sweep stored as legacy-meteor_011_published_30scenes. One rollout per scene, 2026-10-13/14, same referee config as the other rows.
